finding: The first publication normalized ordinary text CRLF to Git LF, so one working-byte checksum was not a valid checksum for both representations.
safeCheckoutAttempt: A scoped restore from the unit's own published commit left already-clean working text unchanged. No unowned file or index entry was changed.
resolution: Distinguish recorded working-raw SHA-256 from canonical Git LF SHA-256 for ordinary text. Keep evidence/raw and evidence/red byte-exact; preserve prior observations, integrity and verification snapshots before intentional recapture.
